project_type: Vanilla JS canvas-based cinematic experience (investor pitch deck)
build_system: Vite (vite.config.js). No npm install possible - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network.
test_framework: No test framework. No test files exist. Validation is AST/syntax-based only.
build_command: NODE_OPTIONS='' npx --no-install vite build 2>/dev/null || echo 'vite not installed - use syntax validation'
test_command: NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check <file> for syntax validation of each new file
verification_instructions: 1. Run node --check on every new/modified JS file to confirm syntax. 2. Verify no import cycles by tracing dependencies. 3. Confirm all exports used by Engine.js exist in the new modules.
setup_instructions: No setup possible. npm registry blocked. All work is source-only. Use NODE_OPTIONS='' prefix.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - npm registry blocked. Cannot run npm install. Cannot run vite build (dependencies not installed). Validation limited to node --check syntax verification. Prefix all node commands with NODE_OPTIONS=''.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow existing patterns: JSDoc comments, zero per-frame allocations, object pooling, no functions > 60 lines, no classes > 400 lines, modular ES modules.
key_patterns: 1. Scenes follow pattern: constructor, getId(), setUniverse(), load(), enter(), update(), leave(), destroy(). 2. Subsystems use MANAGER_STATES lifecycle. 3. Constants in js/config/constants.js (Object.freeze). 4. Settings in js/config/settings.js (Object.freeze nested). 5. SceneDirector drives emotional phases. 6. BehaviorSystem: register/enable/disable pattern. 7. ConnectionRenderer: noise-displaced bezier, max 0.18 opacity, 1.4px width. 8. Engine.js: initSceneXXX() registers, transitionToSceneXXX() handles transition. 9. captureConnectionData() passes midpoint + indices between scenes.
directory_structure: js/config/ (constants.js, settings.js), js/engine/ (Engine.js, SceneDirector.js, other managers), js/engine/universe/ (all universe subsystems), js/scenes/ (SceneXXX.js files + sceneXXX/ phase dirs), js/utils/ (helpers, Noise, math, dom)
